text:
Rowan (CS): quick sync  overnight we had a batch of trial activations slow or stuck in finalization. Need a short, friendly outbound we can personalize, credits, and prioritized enablement slots. draft below.

Felix (Support): how many tenants and what broke? webhook retries, reindex timeouts, or ingestion workers?

Rowan (CS): 9 trial tenants affected (mix of SMB + mid-market). Primary failures: webhook callback retries and reindex finalization timing out due to queued bursts. Window: 03:2203:57 UTC. No customer data leaked. internal list: https://redwood.internal/cs/impacted-trials-2026

OpsBot: INCIDENT-2026-0620 created for onboarding-queue-regression. Severity: P3. Assigned: eng-runtime.

Mei (CS Manager): draft outbound (short, personalize for mid-market):

"Hi [Customer name],

Were sorry  earlier today some onboarding tasks for a few trial accounts were delayed, which slowed activations. Root cause: a routing preference change that briefly sent onboarding bursts to a saturated node pool. We reverted the change and processed the backlog.

What we did: rollback at 03:57 UTC, provisioned temporary burst capacity, and resumed queued reindex jobs.

How well help: a complimentary 30-minute onboarding tune-up (screen share) and a one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of onboarding usage during the impacted window. For accounts flagged as renewal-risk, well offer 20%.

No customer data was exposed. Reply to this message to request an immediate assist or a prioritized time slot.

Feedback form: https://redwood.internal/cs/onboard-incident-feedback

Thanks, Rowan (on behalf of Redwood Inference)"

Arjun (Solutions Eng): add a one-line exec summary for enterprise notes and a tiny tech blurb we can include in the postmortem: "Cause: autoscaler route preference change without saturation checks. Fix: rollback, added saturation guard, and new queue-depth alert."

Sam (Sales Ops): credit flow  we can do flat-percent for trials (10% default), escalate to 20% for renewal-risk. I'll prepare memos and mark AMs to cc. Confirmed.

Felix (Support): suggest send cadence: mid-market/high-touch at 09:00 UTC (AMs cc'd, include local time), SMB at 10:30 UTC. Also include a 2-line "quick checks" snippet customers can run before a session.

Rowan (CS): good call. Quick checks to include:
- confirm webhook endpoint returns 200
- run: `curl -s https://internal/metrics/onboard?tenant_id=... | jq .queue_depth`

Mei (CS Manager): I'll flag renewal-risk accounts in Salesforce and create follow-up tasks for renewals. please log outbound copies to the account timeline.

Arjun (Solutions Eng): postmortem snippet for customers: "Regression in autoscaler route preference caused bursts to land on saturated pools; we rolled back the change, added saturation guards, and implemented queue-depth alerting and a one-off backlog drain." small and non-technical enough for customers.

Sam (Sales Ops): preparing credit memos and AM cc list now. ETA 30m.

Rowan (CS): action items:
- Arjun: provide exec-summary + tech blurb for enterprise notes (ETA 10m)
- Sam: credit memos + AM list (ETA 30m)
- Felix: queue sends (enterprise first) and include calendar stub for prioritized enablement (ETA 20m)
- Mei: SF flags + follow-ups (ETA 20m)

Felix (Support): enterprise batch sent at 09:02 UTC. AMs cc'd. :white_check_mark:

Mei (CS Manager): two enterprise replies requesting immediate assist slots. scheduling now and logging in SF.

Felix (Support): SMB batch sent at 10:32 UTC. low reply volume so far.

Rowan (CS): please capture outcomes in the account health tracker and update renewal-risk if needed. we'll attach eng-runtime's formal RCA when published. add a 24h feedback pulse to the feedback link.

Sam (Sales Ops): credits queued for processing. will update when memos are posted.

(11:05 UTC) Mei (CS Manager): closing coordination thread. reopen if escalations. thanks everyone.
